Resolves #19932

`menu.Panel#afterSetList` calls `this.add(value)` while the panel is still being configured. At that point `layout` is the config object, not an instance (`onConstructed()` creates the instance later). `insert()` then ran `me.layout?.applyChildAttributes(item, index, true)`, and the optional chaining only guards against `null`/`undefined`, so `examples/menu/panel` threw `me.layout?.applyChildAttributes is not a function` and rendered nothing.

The fix is in the engine, as the ticket asks: `insert()` applies the child attributes only when `me.layout` is a `LayoutBase` instance. Nothing is lost by skipping them earlier. `onConstructed()` creates the layout and then runs `createItems()`, which applies `applyChildAttributes` to every item in `_items`, the list included.

Test: `test/playwright/unit/menu/PanelList.spec.mjs` creates a `menu.Panel` with `listConfig` and `listItems`. It checks that the panel's only item is its list, and that the default vbox/stretch layout gave the list its `flex` (`'1 1 0%'`), so the attributes really are applied once the layout exists. On `dev` it fails with `TypeError: me.layout?.applyChildAttributes is not a function`.

- Unit tier: 5339 passed, 3 skipped, 1 failed. The failure is `buildScripts/util/check-examples-body-only.spec.mjs` › "exits 1 (FAIL) on an app.mjs build target missing neo-config.json", which fails the same way on `dev` in my read-only container.
- The example, headless Chromium (Playwright 1.64.1) against `webpack serve`, no network: on `dev` 2 DOM nodes and the error above; with this branch 58 nodes, 5 menu items, no page error (apart from an unrelated `Unexpected token '<'` JSON request that both runs log offline).

While writing the test I noticed that a `menu.Panel` without `listConfig` fails earlier, in `List.construct` (`Cannot read properties of null (reading 'id')`), because `beforeSetList` passes the `null` default into `beforeSetInstance`. That's outside this ticket. I can open an issue for it if it's not intended.

Note: I used Claude Code while working on this.
